title: Top that! What today's geopolitics means for tankers
section_path: Top that! What today's geopolitics means for tankers
section_path_text: Top that! What today's geopolitics means for tankers
summary:
Main
By Henry Curra
Since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in early 2022, geopolitics has kept the freight market analysts guessing. The pace and scope of geopolitical upheavals over the past 5 years has left no shipping sectors untouched. None have been upended more than oil tankers.
